content.description:
This fully on chain project is a study into chaos mathematics.

From the largest structures in the cosmos to the smallest in the quantum realm, mathematics is the language of our universe. Every single calculation is related to the next, and like the universe the whole system is interconnected and creates form through time and space. Like ripples in the sand shifting with ocean waves these patterns evolve into mesmerising formations. This project is here to show you that there is beauty in numbers dancing on the edge of form and chaos.
